text: I snapped at my kid today over nothing and I feel like a terrible parent.
I got passed over for a promotion and now I feel completely worthless.
I can't stop overthinking a text I sent hours ago. Did I say the wrong thing?
I've been feeling kind of numb for weeks and I don't really know why.
I miss my ex so much, even though I know deep down we weren't good together.
I'm scared I'm going to fail my finals and disappoint everyone.
I feel like I'm quietly letting down everyone who counts on me.
I actually had a good day for once and I'm almost suspicious of it.
